question: What fruit does the yogi gain by knowing all declared merit?
premises: yogi knowing all declared merit reaches supreme place
by lord remembrance action impressions become fruitless
in action exhaustion one easily finds supreme shiva
inference: Knowledge of all merit leads the yogi to the supreme place and finally to Shiva.
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are kept as single rows
plain_english: Knowing all declared merit, the yogi reaches the supreme place and, through remembrance of the Lord, easily finds supreme Shiva.
